change: Moved shoulders (Lateral Deltoids) from primary to secondary. In a loaded carry the deltoids stabilize the held load rather than act as prime movers; the prime movers are grip/forearms and the upper traps that hold the shoulder girdle. Kept core, obliques, erector spinae, glutes as secondary stabilizers/propulsion. Trimmed Quads from secondary to stay within format and avoid inflation (legs mainly propel, less dominant than glutes here).
